event_detail: Stove knob: the robot turns a left-side knob and lights the burner under the kettle on the LEFT of the stove (blue flame at 25.6 s); the front right burner, where the pot is, stays off.
evidence: The brown kettle stands upright on a left burner in all four frames, so stage 1 looks done. The gripper works a knob at the front-left (wrist camera shows the knob dial in front of the fingers at 22.4-25.6 s, rotated by the last frame), and at 25.6 s a blue flame ring appears under the kettle on the left side in both shoulder views. The right side of the stove (with the steel pot) shows no flame. If the intended burner is simply the one under the kettle this would count as success, but by the stage text (front right burner) the wrong burner was lit.
